title: Labor coalition to PH, Asean: Stop normalizing Myanmar junta

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Labor coalition NAGKAISA urged the Philippine government and other Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) member states to stop normalizing relations with Myanmar’s military junta, citing continued attacks on civilians and violations of workers’ rights. In a statement, NAGKAISA welcomed the disqualification of Myanmar’s National Human Rights Commission from the Southeast Asia National Human Rights Institutions Forum, announced publicly on Oct. 19. “The decision underscores that a body cannot claim human rights legitimacy simply by name while failing to meet the standards expected of a national human rights institution,” the labor coalition said.
